citations.excerpt: It consisted of 95 general articles, which were signed by Henry at Nantes on the 13th of April 1598

facts.value: Law by which Henry IV of France gave religious liberty to the Huguenots.

citations.excerpt: NANTES, EDICT OF, the law promulgated in April 1598 by which the French king, Henry IV., gave religious liberty to his Protestant subjects, the Huguenots.
